GSC NU Cup​

Welcome to the GSC NU Cup, the seventh of this year's NU Classic Cups! This tournament is part of the 2026 NU Classic Circuit.

GSC NU Resources can be found here.

Tournament Rules:
  • This is a standard GSC NU tournament.
  • Each round will be best-of-three. You may switch teams between games.
  • This tournament will be single-elimination.
  • All matches are to be played on Pokemon Showdown! Games should be played on SmogTours unless both parties agree to play on the main server.
  • Saving replays is mandatory. Posting replays will be mandatory from Round 2.
  • Do not make baseless activity posts. As far as possible, all scheduling should be done in public on Smogon walls.
  • All standard Smogon rules apply.
